The structure of Tm2Mg2 (reduced formula TmMg) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with a unit cell containing 24 atoms (Tm8Mg8) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Mg and Tm centers adopt 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangements, with Mg coordinated by 8 Mg and 4 Tm, and Tm by 8 Mg and 4 Tm. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 24 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Mg-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, as well as corner- and edge-sharing between Mg- and Tm-centered polyhedra.
